title: Sweet Fruit Candy Splash Smash
short_description: Indulge in the ultimate fruit splash and smash puzzle adventure! Developed by Nasar Games, Mega Fruit Splash Candy Sweet Game is the ultimate match-3 puzzle game designed for fruit and candy lovers.
long_description:
Indulge in the ultimate fruit splash and smash puzzle adventure!

Developed by Nasar Games, Mega Fruit Splash Candy Sweet Game is the ultimate match-3 puzzle game designed for fruit and candy lovers. Dive into a vibrant world where you match three or more identical fruits to trigger explosive, colorful splashes. Perfect for relaxing and refreshing your mind, this sweet casual game keeps you entertained with juicy blasts and satisfying mechanics.

Unleash the fruit magic! Match delicious apples, juicy mangoes, sweet pomegranates, and fresh grapes. Create massive combos to unlock powerful fruit bombs that explode across the board, clearing your way to victory. Whether you want to master sweet candy strategies or simply relax in a beautiful splash garden, this is your perfect choice for casual gaming fun.

Key Features:

Addictive Match-3 Gameplay: Connect 3 or more sweet, tasty fruits to blast them away with vibrant color effects.

Magical Fruit Bombs: Smash large groups of fruits together to create powerful explosive boosters that clear the board instantly.

Juicy Arsenal of Flavors: Play with a delicious variety of fruits, including apples, mangoes, pomegranates, grapes, and sweet candies.

Brain-Refreshing Puzzles: Relax your mind and boost your happiness with satisfying, colorful visual feedback on every match.

Stunning Splash Garden Themes: Immerse yourself in beautifully designed levels filled with fresh fruits, sweet candies, and vibrant backgrounds.

title: Bolt Action Sniper Rifle Game. BASRG
short_description: Experience the raw power of legendary sniper rifles including the Kar98k, M24, and AWM. Developed by Nasar Games, Bolt Action Sniper Rifle Game (BASRG) delivers one of the most authentic and thrilling long-range sniping experiences on the Play Store.
long_description:
Bolt Action Sniper Rifle Game (BASRG)

Experience the raw power of legendary sniper rifles including the Kar98k, M24, and AWM.

Developed by Nasar Games, Bolt Action Sniper Rifle Game (BASRG) delivers one of the most authentic and thrilling long-range sniping experiences on the Play Store. Step into the shoes of an elite marksman, lock your target, and pull the trigger to eliminate your enemies with unmatched precision.

Key Features:

Iconic Arsenal: Master the handling and physics of real-world bolt-action sniper rifles like the Kar98k, M24, and AWM.

Massive Weapon Customization: Unlock and collect 30 unique gun skins to personalize your sniper rifle.

Challenging Campaigns: Test your tactical stealth and shooting accuracy across 20 intense missions.

Authentic Ballistics: Feel the tension of real sniping mechanics, bullet trajectories, and heavy impact action.

Proudly developed by an independent indie game creator dedicated to bringing you a premium, focused tactical sniping simulator.

title: Honor to the Brave: Tank Game 3D
short_description: Fight for your country and defeat the enemy and capture the enemy area. Welcome to the battlefield of tanks game. Are you ready to drive the tank and defeat the enemy and remove the enemy tanks from your area?
long_description:
Fight for your country and defeat the enemy and capture the enemy area

Welcome to the battlefield of tanks game. Are you ready to drive the tank and defeat the enemy and remove the enemy tanks from your area? Get hands-on with this game and fight the war with opponents. The army of your country is alert and fighting with tanks and aircraft with another country's enemy to protect their motherland. The Heroes have left their homes and picked their weapons and gone to war against the enemy of their country.

Honor to the Brave: Tank Game 3D is a tank shooting action game where you pick your tank from different types of modern tank machines. You upgrade the tanks to improve their damage, armor, and speed. You can also choose different types of skins and be the pro player of the world in this Ukrainian army tank game. Different nations are fighting like the USA, UK, Russia, China, Ukraine, and other countries, you fight for your army and county and protect from enemies by shooting their vehicles and tanks with your powerful weapons like cannons aircraft and tanks, etc.

Wide Range of Tanks
This game has a wide range of different types of tanks. From small, quick, and fast tanks to heavy, powerful, and beast tanks. They have different specifications and features like speed, armor, power, reload time, etc.

A lot of Maps
The game has a lot of maps to choose from. Now enjoy the war of nations in different types of environments like mountains, cities, deserts, snow and plains and different types of special areas.

Different and Interesting Game Mods
This army fighting war tank game has a lot of mods like tanks Team Deathmatch (TDM), tanks Battle royale mod and capture the flag or area and different types of story mods, etc.

Easy Controls and High Graphics
The game has easy controls, a smooth driving experience, and accurate shooting with high-quality graphics.

Enjoy Online and Offline
The game has an Offline tank mod and also online tank battle mods. Enjoy both modes by practicing in the offline mode and implementing the tricks and experience in the online game with different players from all around the world. Make friends and fight in a team.
